Write a Python script in `/workspace` that flattens
`[[1, 2], [3], [4, 5]]`.

Use `pyt` if the Design Phase library is installed, otherwise use
`more-itertools` if it is available in the dependency cache, otherwise use a
self-contained fallback. Print a `CUTOVER_CHECK pyt:02_step mode=<mode>` line
before the JSON result.
